records.title: Botswana Ministry of Lands and Agriculture
records.description: Official ministry portal covering agricultural development, crop production, animal production, agribusiness promotion, veterinary services and plant health.

records.title: Botswana agricultural farmer training services
records.description: Government rural training centres provide courses in crop production, animal production, agricultural marketing, agro-processing and conservation of natural resources.

records.title: Botswana Thuo Letlotlo livestock support programme
records.description: Official programme guidelines cover livestock production packages, beneficiary training and eligibility requirements for citizen farmers and agricultural businesses.
